column1: # The refusals of camera_core::sensor_mounts and camera_core_py.sensor_mounts for a camera, which
# both suites hold byte for byte: on each line a call, its arguments and the message of its refusal,
# separated by tabs. sensor_name takes a copy and an instance id; sensor_frame takes the name it asks
# for and the sensor_names, sensor_kinds, sensor_frames and carried_by of an answer, each a list
# separated by commas, an empty field none. In an argument, \u{X} is the character of code point X.
